name: test_register_user_with_password_matching_existing_user_is_rejected_cleanly
description: Verifies that reusing another user's password on a new username is a clean 4xx, not a server crash.
descriptionHtml: Verifies that reusing another user's password on a new username is a clean 4xx, not a server crash.
statusMessage:
XFAIL TM-28 (docs/known-defects-and-improvements.md): POST /users crashes with 500 whenever the submitted password matches an already-registered user's password, regardless of username. Remove xfail once the defect is fixed.

AssertionError: expected a clean 200/400/409 for a reused password, got 500 (body: Internal Server Error)
assert 500 in (200, 400, 409)

    @allure.feature("Users")
    @pytest.mark.api
    @pytest.mark.negative
    @pytest.mark.xfail(
        reason="TM-28 (docs/known-defects-and-improvements.md): POST /users crashes with 500 whenever the "
        "submitted password matches an already-registered user's password, regardless of username. "
        "Remove xfail once the defect is fixed.",
        strict=True,
    )
    def test_register_user_with_password_matching_existing_user_is_rejected_cleanly(
        api_client, unique_name, settings
    ):
        """Verifies that reusing another user's password on a new username is a clean 4xx, not a server crash."""
        existing_password = settings.user().password
        username = f"qa_{unique_name()}"
    
        response = api_client.users.create_user(username, existing_password)
